title: Efficient Zero-Shot Video Anomaly Detection via Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF)
abstract: arXiv:2610.32486v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying Vision-Language Models for video anomaly detection confronts a fundamental constraint. Their semantic reasoning demands computational budgets incompatible with the scale of real-world video streams. We present Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF), a framework that achieves efficient zero-shot anomaly detection through three key innovations. First, we introduce a dual-signal adaptive sampler operating in semantic embedding space: a delta signal captures sudden events via frame-to-frame cosine distance, while a drift signal detects static and gradual anomalies through deviation from rolling temporal context. Their OR-gated combination with adaptive EMA-based thresholding provides comprehensive anomaly coverage without training data. Second, we propose a threshold-gated cascaded architecture where lightweight frame-level scoring precedes expensive video-level temporal analysis, invoking it only when confidence warrants additional

translated_title: 基于信号感知自适应融合（SAAF）的高效零样本视频异常检测
translated_abstract: 将视觉语言模型部署于视频异常检测面临一个根本性约束：其语义推理所需的计算预算与真实世界视频流的规模不兼容。我们提出信号感知自适应融合（SAAF）框架，通过三项关键创新实现高效的零样本异常检测。首先，我们引入一种在语义嵌入空间中运行的双信号自适应采样器：增量信号通过帧间余弦距离捕捉突发事件，而漂移信号通过与滚动时间上下文的偏差检测静态和渐进式异常。二者通过OR门控组合，并结合基于自适应指数移动平均（EMA）的阈值处理，无需任何训练数据即可实现全面的异常覆盖。其次，我们提出一种阈值门控的级联架构，由轻量级的帧级评分先行处理，仅当置信度需要进一步分析时才调用昂贵的视频级时序分析。
tldr: SAAF框架通过双信号自适应采样器（增量信号捕捉突发事件、漂移信号检测静态与渐进异常）以及阈值门控的级联架构，在无需训练数据的情况下实现了高效且全面的零样本视频异常检测。
en_tdlr: SAAF achieves efficient, training-free zero-shot video anomaly detection via a dual-signal adaptive sampler (delta signal for sudden events and drift signal for static/gradual anomalies) combined with a threshold-gated cascaded architecture.
